text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The Estonia Concert Hall was reopened after a 16 million kroon renovation, ready for a concert by Montserrat Caballe on September 14.
- The chairman of the German Bundestag foreign affairs commission Karl-Heinz Hornhues, on a three-day visit to Estonia, met parliament chairman Toomas Savi and Prime Minister Mart Siimann.
- Shareholders of earth metal plant Silmet decided to annul its current shares and prepare a new issue in two months.
- The government and trade union TALO continued negotiations over pay in state institutions in 1998.
- Tallinn organisation, the Russian Citizens Union, issued a statement, calling on people without residence permits to a campaign of civil disobedience and not to register in immigration offices.
